summary: Audited inventory for T1 item 10 (Repo hygiene): .github/workflows/ci.yml, LICENSE, README.md, spec/target-spec.md with the stated assertions. Every member file is listed with its sha256 and signoff/check.py re-derives the inventory from the live tree, so the bound hash proves the inventory is current and the member hashes prove the files it describes are. It does not run a simulation or re-derive any measured value.
